title: Outlook will not open
symptom: Outlook does not start or closes immediately
user_description: I click Outlook and it either does nothing or opens and disappears. I need to read an email from a client.

options.why: Destroys his emails and is far too drastic. The mailbox is almost certainly fine.

options.text: Note the exact error, restart Outlook (and the PC if needed), and check whether the mailbox works in the web version
options.why: The exact error points to the cause, and a restart fixes many glitches. If the web version works, the mailbox is fine and the problem is only the desktop app.
Never the first step. It is a huge, destructive fix for a problem that is usually small.

options.text: Tell him to wait until tomorrow
options.why: Leaves the user without email and avoids finding the cause.

hints: Is the problem with the mailbox or the app on this PC?
How else could he read his email while you fix it?
real_world_tip: Offering the web version straight away lets the user keep working while you troubleshoot the desktop app.
